cited_by.title: Hair growth oils and supplements: castor, rosemary, black seed, biotin

record.design: Double-blind randomised three-arm trial over 90 days: rosemary-lavender oil, rosemary-castor oil, coconut oil comparator
record.finding: The rosemary blends improved phototrichogram hair growth rate, thickness, density and length against coconut oil (p<0.0001); growth rate rose from 0.22 to 0.34 mm a day in the rosemary-lavender arm.
record.note: A branded product; the comparator is coconut oil, not an untreated group; funding not checked. Healthy adults, not selected for afro hair. PubMed lists an erratum (Cureus 2026;18(6):c452, PMID 42318379, opened 12 Nov 2026); it corrects only the clinical trial registry number (a typo; the corrected number is CTRI/2024/07/070860) and changes no result. One author is affiliated with Soulflower Pvt Ltd (R&D); the correction states no competing interests.
